comparison.objective: Install and quarter-turn-lock a two-pin lamp tube in two sockets; candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber, then validates carriage dynamics.
comparison.physical_skill: Shared bimanual stabilization and rotation, but lamp task tests simultaneous dual-end pin alignment/insertion and coordinated tube turning; candidate tests recessed hex-key use, setscrew release, fine collar adjustment, torque-limited relocking, and response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Lamp requires both ends within 3 mm, detents engaged near 90°, release, and stability; candidate requires two ≥0.85 J cycles within stroke/rebound/overload/drift limits and forbids energized adjustment or hard-stop impact.
comparison.reason: The tested mechanisms and feedback loops differ meaningfully; generic insertion and rotation do not establish overlap. Missing rubric details: lamp contact-force limits and damage thresholds are unspecified, but this does not obscure the distinction.
